cat > programs/task-90b531be.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate monochrome 3x3 blocks (the structured objects).
    blocks=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v and all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(r,r+3) for j in range(c,c+3)):
                # ensure top-left of block
                if r and c and g[r-1][c-1]==v: continue
                blocks.append((r+1,c+1,v))
    # Draw full row/column beams, with blank cells where beams cross.
    centers=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in blocks]
    crossings={(r,c) for r,c,v in centers for rr,cc,vv in centers if v!=vv and r==rr and c==cc}
    # Each object's horizontal/vertical lines; crossings between beams are gaps.
    for r,c,v in centers:
        for j in range(w): g[r][j]=v
        for i in range(h): g[i][c]=v
    # A perpendicular crossing occurs where one center row meets another center column.
    for r,c,v in centers:
        for rr,cc,vv in centers:
            if v!=vv:
                if r==rr and c!=cc: g[r][cc]=0
                if c==cc and r!=rr: g[rr][c]=0
                # general crossing of horizontal beam r and vertical beam cc
                g[r][cc]=0
                g[rr][c]=0
    return g
PY
